(কাস্টমস)
প্রজ্ঞাপন
তারিখ, ১৭ আষাঢ়, ১৪২৪ বঙ্গাব্দ/০১ জুলাই, ২০১৭ খ্রিস্টাব্দ

Customs Act 1969: Section 18, sub-section (2) of this Act empowers the Government to impose or adjust regulatory duties on imported goods.
The Act provides the legislative framework for the First Schedule, which classifies goods and determines import duty rates.
Import Duty: This order adjusts the rate of import duty to 3% for a wide range of goods that currently fall under the 25% statutory duty rate category, excluding specifically listed items or those exempted by other notifications and orders.
Regulatory Duty: This order imposes a specific regulatory duty on the commodities listed in Table-II, with rates ranging between 3% and 35% depending on the specific H.S. Code and product description.
First Schedule: The First Schedule of the Customs Act is the reference document for identifying H.S. Codes and the corresponding statutory import duty rates that are now subject to the amendments made by this order.
TABLE-I: This table lists specific goods, identified by H.S. Code and description, that are explicitly excluded from the 3% import duty adjustment established in this order.
TABLE-II: This table specifies the regulatory duty rates applicable to various commodities, defined by H.S. Code and description, as mandated by this order.
